subject: Parameters of multivariate normal distribution in the simulateData() function

messages.author: e0e3c26c69574a48
messages.subject: Parameters of multivariate normal distribution in the simulateData() function
parts:
Hi all,

I have some questions about using the simulateData() function. I know that the function generates a dataset based on the multivariate normal distribution. However, I cannot find the exact reference that states the parameter values of the multivariate normal distribution used. Could anyone tell me what they are?

Also, if I use the below code to generate a dataset,

```
library(lavaan)

# specify population model
population.model <- ' f1 =~ x1 + 0.8*x2 + 1.2*x3
                      f2 =~ x4 + 0.5*x5 + 1.5*x6
                      f3 =~ x7 + 0.1*x8 + 0.9*x9

                      f3 ~ 0.5*f1 + 0.6*f2
                    '

# generate data
set.seed(1234)
myData <- simulateData(population.model, sample.nobs=100L)

# population moments
fitted(sem(population.model))
```

The fitted() function shows the population moments, especially the population covariance. However, the population mean is not shown. How can I know the population means?

Thanks for your time!

Best,
Ihnwhi

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Parameters of multivariate normal distribution in the simulateData() function
parts: The fitted() function shows the population moments, especially the population covariance. However, the population mean is not shown. How can I know the population means?

fitted(sem(population.model, meanstructure = TRUE))

They are zero, unless stated otherwise in your syntax (which would automatically trigger meanstructure=TRUE)
